text: uh. something is very wrong not with any update im aware of though, i just started up the app, the map i have loaded is literally empty, and im sitting at 4.5g memory usage and its all reporting in as unattributed [Image #1]
resolution: Confirmed the 4.5GB reading was real private anonymous RSS, stable rather than an idle leak, and isolated the cold shader compile process from the warm-cache baseline. The orphaned 4.5GB process was terminated at the user's request. Added native allocation and GPU-capacity evidence so future peaks are diagnosable.
